name: Tetsudou Nippon! Real Pro Tokkyuu Romance Car! Odakyu Dentetsu-hen
summary:
A train simulation game from Sonic Powered's "Japanese Rail Sim" series.

In this entry, you can drive the famous "Romancecar" express trains on the entirety of the Odakyu Electric Railway.

This game is compatible with Zuiki's Densha de GO!! dedicated one-handle train controller for the Nintendo Switch.
